scenes.text: Have you ever glanced at a ticking clock and felt like the second hand froze in place for just a fraction too long?
Your brain is actually lying to you to protect your vision, temporarily going blind when you shift your gaze to prevent a dizzying blur.
To hide this sudden gap in consciousness, your mind retroactively stretches time backward, making you think you've been looking at the clock longer than you have.
Your mind literally rewires your perception of time to keep your reality stable, so let me know in the comments if you have ever experienced this eerie freeze!
